title: Kissed Kenyan Masarepa Pilaf
description: A Satvik-friendly Kenyan dish featuring yellow masarepa, perfect for a wine and cheese date night. The pillowy texture and winey flavor make this recipe a must-try.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine 1 3/4 cups of water and 2 tablespoons of melted unsalted butter over medium heat, whisking constantly until the butter dissolves into a smooth paste.
Add in 2 teaspoons of grated ginger and 2 tablespoons of brown sugar, whisking until well combined.
Add in 250g of yellow masarepa, whisking until well incorporated.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 5 minutes, or until the mixture has thickened and formed a creamy paste.
Remove from heat and stir in 1/4 cup of crushed dates and 1/4 cup of white wine.
Season with 1/4 teaspoon of kosher salt and 1/8 teaspoon of ground black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional dates if desired.
